purpose: Planned behavior and source-evidence map; not a completed per-file implementation or runtime proof.

policies.LIST: Quiet bounded list refresh preserving context
policies.FORM: Original-state write + explicit typed three-way merge + draft retention
policies.CANVAS: Change summary and explicit pull with independent draft/viewport preservation
policies.COMMAND: Owner-specific intent, conditional basis and known/unknown result, not generic merge
policies.STREAM: Append/stream identity; preserve unrelated local composer
policies.READ_ONLY: Read-only projection updates, no edit protocol
policies.OVERLAY: Shared modal and notification interaction layer
policies.EXCLUDED_FROM_MERGE: No universal editor merge; existing owner semantics remain

evidence_states.DIRECT: Current source inspected for the stated path; no automatic whole-module closure.
evidence_states.DOC_CURRENT: Maintained repository document inspected; current implementation still needs local confirmation.
evidence_states.HISTORICAL_CHECK_REQUIRED: Historical audit used only as a discovery seed, not proof of a current defect.
evidence_states.TREE_DISCOVERY: Surface family identified; exact local renderer/handler decomposition is required.
evidence_states.DOC_CURRENT/PERIMETER_OPEN: Documented behavior exists; all participating write paths were not directly inspected.
evidence_states.DIRECT/PERIMETER_OPEN: A current path was directly inspected, but its complete write perimeter remains open.
evidence_states.DIRECT/DOC_CURRENT: Current source and maintained architecture document jointly support the bounded entry.
evidence_states.DIRECT_ADAPTER/DOC_OWNER: Current adapter inspected; owner guarantees are taken from a maintained document.
evidence_states.DIRECT_FACADE/OWNER_OPEN: Current facade inspected; the underlying owner has not been directly closed.
evidence_states.DIRECT_GRANT/OTHER_OPEN: Current grant implementation inspected; other connection/permission paths remain open.
